case_name: A named face: text, one photo, two photos
group_name: Tool capability: frames from real references
title: Lincoln from memory

turns.text: Make a photorealistic colour photo of Abraham Lincoln standing on the shore of Moraine Lake in Banff National Park, looking out at the mountains. Daylight, 16:9.

tests: Text only: does a free model know Lincoln's face and Moraine Lake without a reference?

answer_sheet.Who and where: Abraham Lincoln at Moraine Lake, Banff.

must_haves: The man is recognisably Abraham Lincoln (the beard without a moustache, the gaunt face, the dark hair).
The lake is a turquoise mountain lake with a wall of jagged peaks behind it, like Moraine Lake.
He stands on the shore looking at the mountains.
The picture is a photorealistic colour photo, 16:9.
